method.linkerReplayScope: Exact replay of retained wasm-ld operands with unchanged output basename. Pre-postlink WASM compared against original debug snapshot from verified rebuild. Archive extraction precedes optimization/dead-code elimination.
method.sourceMappingScope: SDK source candidates from pinned SDK Library.get_files and object naming, validated against complete archive member-name sets. Selected member bytes are pinned, but SDK archives were not independently reconstructed from these sources.
